description: Building skill (design docs/specs/2026-11-14-build-design.md). Task ids are generator seeds of minecraftrl.build_task.generate_build; train, dev and final ids never overlap (their blueprints can repeat; the world seeds differ). The embedding is the official STEVE-1 prior output for the prompt (made with scripts/prepare_demo_prompts.py --set build); sha256 null = not made yet, and only the teacher check may run. occluded: the occlusion check tasks (docs/specs/2026-11-15-build-occluded-check-design.md), each with a block in front of its first cell (build_recover.occluded_build), on world seed 707106. Round 4 (docs/specs/2026-11-15-build-careful-design.md): occluded_train on the training seeds, dev4 and dev4_occluded on 302585, final4 and final4_occluded on 866025; the occluded lists are the first 8 ids from 501, 701 and 901 with a free cell in front of the first cell and a blueprint and block not already picked. large: the size check (docs/specs/2026-11-15-build-large-check-design.md), larger blueprints from minecraftrl.build_large.large_build (ids 1001-1008 cover each of its 4 shapes twice) on world seed 693147. Round 5 (docs/specs/2026-11-15-build-repair-design.md): repair tasks (minecraftrl.build_repair.repair_build, id % 3 stray blocks next to the blueprint) in repair_train on the training seeds, repair_dev on 414213 and repair_final on 236067.
